item.title: Saturday Sessions: Christone "Kingfish" Ingram performs "Voodoo Charm"
item.description: Grammy Award-winning guitarist and singer-songwriter Christone "Kingfish" Ingram brings Mississippi blues tradition to his captivating live performances. Kingfish has played with everyone from Vampire Weekend to Gary Clark Jr. and contributed to the score for the Oscar-winning movie "Sinners." Kingfish's latest album, "Hard Road," is described as his "most sophisticated and musically ambitious collection yet." Here's Kingfish with "Voodoo Charm."
